svg.title: Lyre-harp frame, 30mm bore, 188 x 400mm - cheek B, the back - CUT THIS SHEET ONCE
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. cheek B, the back - CUT THIS SHEET ONCE. A closed duct 30mm deep between two cheeks, 30mm wide over the arch and down the parallel sides and opening to the full gap between the hole and the outer wall below the hole, which is the resonator. 49 wall panels, numbered round each wall; each cheek slot carries its panel's number. 3mm ply, slots for a 3mm sheet at 0.13mm kerf, joints cut to the fit of 0.25. Blue #0000ff engraves, orange #ff8000 cuts the slots first, black #000000 frees the parts.
